synopsis: ODD-UM is a 2022 conference paper that developed an operating-domain taxonomy for underground mining by adapting BSI PAS 1883 and ISO 17757:2019 [f6711, f9362, f7185]. Across the corpus, it is grouped with the 2024 unstructured-environment ODD work and the November 2025 agricultural ODD preprint as academic off-road domain work, not standards [f6710, f6785, f7185]. These publications offer useful concepts for off-road work, but their non-standard status remains a limitation for planners [f7186]. Chapter 9 uses ODD-UM and EMESRT as off-road inputs to a proposed taxonomy alongside ISO 34503 and OpenODD on-road patterns; that arrangement is explicitly expert opinion [f6714].
